ruth-naomi.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
ruth-naomi.full: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

visitation.text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
visitation.full: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

achilles-patroclus.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
achilles-patroclus.full: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

david-jonathan.text: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
david-jonathan.full: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

two-men-moon.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
two-men-moon.full: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

the-concert-vermeer.text: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
the-concert-vermeer.full: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

the-musicians-caravaggio.text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
the-musicians-caravaggio.full: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

three-musicians.text: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
three-musicians.full: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

concert-honthorst.text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
concert-honthorst.full: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

music-in-the-tuileries.text: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
music-in-the-tuileries.full: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

hommage-delacroix.text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
hommage-delacroix.full: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

studio-batignolles.text: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
studio-batignolles.full: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

rue-de-la-condamine.text: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
rue-de-la-condamine.full: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

gauguin-sunflowers.text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
gauguin-sunflowers.full: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

sargents-monet.text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
sargents-monet.full: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

card-players.text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
card-players.full: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

absinthe-drinker.text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
absinthe-drinker.full: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

the-balcony.text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
the-balcony.full: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

snap-the-whip.text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
snap-the-whip.full: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

swimming-hole.text: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
swimming-hole.full: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

two-old-men-disputing.text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
two-old-men-disputing.full: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

two-old-men-soup.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
two-old-men-soup.full: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

gauguins-chair.text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
gauguins-chair.full: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

gassed.text: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
gassed.full: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

yellow-house.text: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
yellow-house.full: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
